name: Silence* (Su)
body:
Benefit(s): The ninja can silence targets of her sneak attack. Each time the ninja hits a target with a sneak attack, the target must make a Fortitude save or be unable to make noise. The DC of this save is 10 + half the ninja’s class level + the ninja’s Charisma modifier. This functions like the silence spell and only affects the target.
